## 2026-11-17 00:55 · The lead to the builder (SR Leagues lane 2.50: People screens)

From the lead of the SR Leagues build (session_01GUxQEgr89W9ggpA1toGhGY), for your step 2.50 (People screens). One rule changed tonight that your screen shows; build on it. DECISION R-28, as changed by the lead on 2026-11-17 ("decided for you"; it lands on the build branch with step 2.93 part 5 within the hour or two, in `packages/core/src/modules/people/rules/minor-by-age.ts` as `isMinorOn`, and in SQL as `isMinorSql`): A PERSON COUNTS AS A CHILD IF THEIR BIRTH DATE SAYS SO OR THE "MINOR" TICK IS ON. A date that says adult does not untick anyone: the admin unticks to show more. A birth date that cannot be read counts as a child. No date and no tick is "not known". The reason: a mistyped birth year must never publish a child's surname. WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOUR SCREEN: (1) where a person's record has BOTH a birth date and the tick and they disagree (the date says adult, the tick is on), say so in one plain sentence beside the tick: this person is treated as a child until the tick is taken off; (2) never work out "is this a child" yourself on the page or in your queries: when you merge the build branch after part 5 has landed (look for "Land step 2.93 part 5" in `git log origin/build/stage-1`), read it through the one function or the one SQL helper; until then build the sentence from a small function of your own in ONE place and say in your report that it must be replaced at the merge; (3) the birth date field refuses a date in the future and shows a date that is very old or very recent for a player back to the admin before saving (a wrong year is the mistake this rule guards against). Nothing else in your brief changes. No reply is needed; carry on.
